1) 在各 mon 节点用 chronyc tracking 确认偏移量与上游源: 1) On each mon node run chronyc tracking to check the offset and upstream source state; 2) Confirm every mon node uses the same set of NTP sources; 3) Start chronyd where it is not running and enable it at boot; where the offset is large, use chronyc makestep to step the clock; 4) After correcting the time, confirm with ceph -s that the clock skew warning is gone.
1) 用 ceph -s 与 ceph health detail 看集群整体状: 1) Run ceph -s and ceph health detail for the overall state and the specific warnings; 2) Use ceph pg dump_stuck and ceph pg <pgid> query to locate the stuck PGs and why; 3) In most cases the root cause is a down OSD or a full disk — restore the OSD or free space and the PGs return to active+clean automatically; 4) Watch with ceph -w during recovery and avoid other operations that add load.
1) 用 ceph health detail 找出不一致的 PG，再用 rad: 1) Use ceph health detail to find the inconsistent PGs, then rados list-inconsistent-obj <pgid> for the specific objects; 2) Run ceph pg repair <pgid> to trigger repair — Ceph overwrites from the authoritative copy; 3) Before repairing, confirm which copy is bad: if the primary itself is corrupt, verify the authoritative copy is trustworthy first; 4) An OSD that repeatedly produces inconsistencies should have its SMART checked — it is usually bad sectors and the disk should be replaced.
1) 用 ceph health detail 看具体是哪些 WARN 项；2): 1) Run ceph health detail to see exactly which WARN items are present; 2) Common ones are a single down OSD, PGs not clean, clock skew and pools without pg_autoscale; 3) Work through them following the guidance — Ceph's health detail usually gives explicit instructions; 4) Once done, confirm ceph -s returns to HEALTH_OK.
1) 用 ceph osd df 找出空间不足的 OSD；2) 释放空间或扩容: 1) Run ceph osd df to find the OSDs short on space; 2) Freeing space or adding OSDs is the real fix; 3) As an emergency measure raise osd_backfill_full_ratio so backfill continues, but only if the disks genuinely have headroom; 4) Avoid taking further OSDs offline before backfill completes, or redundancy drops further.
1) 用 ceph osd df 看各 OSD 使用率分布，确认是个别 OSD: 1) Run ceph osd df to see the utilization spread and whether it is one OSD or the cluster as a whole; 2) For a single hot OSD, check ceph balancer status and run ceph balancer on if it is disabled; 3) If the cluster as a whole is near full you must add OSDs, or first delete unused pools/snapshots to free space; 4) Temporarily raising mon_osd_full_ratio buys time but is a dangerous operation and must be paired with real expansion.
1) 用 ceph osd perf 看各 OSD 的 commit/apply: 1) Run ceph osd perf to see commit/apply latency per OSD and whether it is isolated or widespread; 2) For a single slow OSD, go to that node and use iostat -x 1 and smartctl to check disk health and saturation; 3) If it is widespread, check whether a large recovery/backfill is running and lower osd_max_backfills to reduce the impact; 4) For a failing disk, follow the replacement procedure.
1) 用 ceph osd tree 确认是哪个 OSD 被降权、当前权重多少；: 1) Run ceph osd tree to see which OSD is down-weighted and to what; 2) Determine whether it was a manual reweight or an automatic reweight-by-utilization; 3) If the fault is resolved, run ceph osd reweight <id> 1.0 to restore the weight and let data backfill; 4) If it was down-weighted to balance capacity, consider using the balancer module instead.
1) 用 ceph osd tree 确认是哪个 OSD、在哪个节点；2) 到该: 1) Run ceph osd tree to identify the OSD and its node; 2) On that node use systemctl status ceph-osd@<id> and its logs to find the cause (disk failure, OOM, process crash); 3) If the disk is fine, just start the OSD; if the disk failed, follow the replacement procedure and ceph osd out to migrate data away; 4) Watch recovery progress with ceph -s and avoid taking more OSDs offline.
1) 用 ceph pg \u003cpgid\u003e query 看 do: 1) Run ceph pg <pgid> query to see why it is down, focusing on which OSDs blocked_by points to; 2) Bringing those OSDs back online is the most direct fix — usually a disk or host failure; 3) If an OSD genuinely cannot be recovered, assess the data loss risk of an osd lost operation before running it; 4) Record every step: decisions involving data loss should be reviewed by a second person.
1) 用 df -h 确认 /var/lib/ceph/mon 所在分区的余量；: 1) Run df -h to check the free space on the partition holding /var/lib/ceph/mon; 2) The most common reason the mon directory grows is a cluster that has been unclean for a long time, preventing osdmap trimming — fix the cluster health first; 3) Run ceph tell mon.<id> compact to trigger rocksdb compaction and reclaim space; 4) Longer term, give mon its own larger disk.
1) 确认 ceph exporter / mgr 所在节点是否存活，进程是否运: 1) Confirm the node running ceph exporter / mgr is alive and the process is running; 2) Run ceph -s on any mon node to confirm by hand whether the cluster itself is healthy; 3) A failed mgr causes many metrics to disappear — run ceph mgr fail to switch to the standby mgr; 4) After collection resumes, note the data gap and remember there were no alerts during the blind window.
1) 立即用 ceph health detail 看具体是哪一项 ERR；2): 1) Immediately run ceph health detail to see which ERR item it is; 2) Common ones are inactive/incomplete PGs, many down OSDs, or a full OSD forcing the cluster read-only; 3) Restore the down OSDs or free space on the full OSD first — this is the root cause of the vast majority of ERRs; 4) Do not scale or adjust the crush map during recovery, as it worsens data migration.
Ceph 的采集目标不可达，监控已经看不到集群状态——此时集群可能正在出问题却没: The Ceph scrape target is unreachable and monitoring can no longer see cluster state — the cluster could be failing right now with no alerts at all.
Ceph 集群健康状态为 HEALTH_ERR，这是最高级别的异常，通常意味着有: Ceph cluster health is HEALTH_ERR, the most severe state, usually meaning data is inaccessible or at risk of loss.
Ceph 集群处于 HEALTH_WARN。虽然数据仍可访问，但已经有需要处理的: The Ceph cluster is in HEALTH_WARN. Data is still accessible, but there is a problem that needs handling — left alone it usually escalates to ERR.
Monitor 节点可用存储低于 30%。mon 的数据目录写满会导致 mon: Monitor node free storage is below 30%. A full mon data directory prevents the mon from writing maps and drags down the whole cluster's metadata service.
Monitor 节点间时钟偏移超过 0.1 秒。Ceph 的 mon 选举与租约: Clock skew between monitor nodes exceeds 0.1 seconds. Ceph's mon elections and leases depend on clock agreement, so a large skew causes repeated re-elections and stalls cluster metadata operations.
OSD 的 apply 延迟超过 10 秒，写入已经严重堆积，客户端会感受到明显: OSD apply latency exceeds 10 seconds: writes are badly backed up and clients will experience noticeable stalls or hung IO.
PG 回填因目标 OSD 空间不足而停滞，数据无法完成再平衡，冗余度恢复被卡住。: PG backfill has stalled because the target OSD is short on space; data cannot finish rebalancing and redundancy recovery is blocked.
有 OSD 使用率超过 90%。Ceph 在 OSD 达到 full ratio: An OSD is more than 90% used. Once an OSD reaches the full ratio, Ceph makes the entire cluster read-only — the blast radius is far wider than a single disk.
有 OSD 处于 down 状态，集群冗余下降，Ceph 会启动数据再平衡，期间: An OSD is down: cluster redundancy is reduced and Ceph will start rebalancing data, with performance impact during the process.
有 OSD 的 reweight 值小于 1，说明它被人工或自动降权，该 OSD: An OSD has a reweight below 1, meaning it was down-weighted manually or automatically; it will hold less data than expected, possibly a leftover state from earlier fault handling.
有 PG 不处于 active 状态，对应的数据当前不可访问，客户端 IO 会: Some PGs are not active: the corresponding data is currently inaccessible and client IO will hang.
有 PG 副本间数据不一致（通常由 scrub 发现的坏道引起），存在读到错误数: PG replicas are inconsistent (usually found by scrub after bad sectors), so there is a risk of reading incorrect data.
有 PG 处于 down 状态，这些 PG 上的数据当前完全不可读写，是数据可用: Some PGs are down: the data on them is currently completely unreadable and unwritable — this is a data availability incident.
有 PG 处于 incomplete 状态，说明缺少足够的副本来保证数据完整，该: Some PGs are incomplete, meaning there are not enough replicas to guarantee data integrity, and reads and writes on those PGs are blocked.
有 PG 长时间处于 activating 状态，这些 PG 上的读写会被阻塞。: Some PGs have been stuck in the activating state and reads and writes on them are blocked.
